dedupe_keys.name: french collective farmers stores and closures through 2024

description: INRAE and its partners assembled a French inventory of collective farmers’ retail stores, a form of food outlet governed by producer groups. The Data in Brief article describes identifying stores through local newspapers, a participatory map and agricultural-development partners, then linking SIRET business identifiers where possible. The current Recherche Data Gouv metadata lists 543 active stores in 2024 and 105 that had closed over the preceding fifteen years. Its public version 3 release includes two tabular files, a variable dictionary and English and French README files. The repository licence is Etalab Open Licence 2.0, with no file marked restricted. Coverage is this store type in France, not all food retailers, farm output or observed freight flows. Missed stores, uneven local reporting and uncertain opening or closure dates are limitations for reconstructing a complete network history. A reviewer-assessed use is locating local food-distribution nodes or testing store closures in an agent-based supply simulation. model-comses-food-supply-chain-resilience-efficiency is a related modelling resource, but no store-level input was created. No tabular file was downloaded or inspected.
